question: Which selected native command forms an army, and does it establish a safe first-capital Archer army grant?

scope.boundary: Selected command-name cells, one dispatch arm, the complete selected eligibility and formation owners, adjacent field-clear/creation owner, and selected CityCreate frame/first-capital words. An incidental eight-word prefix before CityCreate entry supplies no semantic claim. Unit creation, killing, indirect callback bodies, native marker persistence and network delivery are not expanded.

Accepted dispatcher table: type10 selects0x82CE026C and type11 selects0x82CE02A0; numeric command identity does not prove delivery.
Bounded ordinary creator and founding origin/lifetime qualifications.
Previously accepted nonzero live-unit+0x4 army-name selector.

eligibility.inputs: r3=p,r4=j; U=0x830F2BF0+84*(256*p+j). Native callers must supply valid owner/slot and readable retained records.
eligibility.earlyGates: 0x82D008F8..0900 rejects nonzero U+0x4.0x82D00918..0934 rejects definition+0x50 intersecting0x8081.0x82D00938..094C rejects the current Barbarian ordinal and UnitType7. If U16[0x8314F1C8] is nonzero,0x82D00964..0970 requires p equal to NativeLocalPlayer0x82D8A3A0; the flag's broader meaning is unassigned.
eligibility.matchingRecords: The four-way unrolled loop0x82D0098C..0x82D00B24 scans256 records in p's pool. It counts records with owner byte!=255, clear unit+0xC sign bit, matching X/Y at+0x1C/+0x1E, matching type+0x1 and zero army selector+0x4. The selected unit is not excluded from this count.
eligibility.return: 0x82D00BD4..0x82D00BE8 returns1 for count>=3, otherwise0, under normal ABI retention. Local-player paths can issue virtual+0x80 notifications before that return, including a count2 path; the eligibility helper is not generally side-effect-free.

formation.memberSelection: The loop0x82D136B4..0x82D13890 scans ascending slots0..255 in p's pool. It skips owner255, unit+0xC sign-bit records, selected j, coordinate/type mismatch, nonzero army selector and matches after two were selected. For each of the first two matches it combines state and calls UnitKill0x82D02390(p,member,0) at0x82D1387C. No explicit member-ID arguments or per-kill success checks exist in this selected owner.
formation.combinedState: Selected rank+0x5 contributes to a sum; special-upgrade words+0x10 are ORed, halfwords+0x52 are ANDed, and signed halfword+0x36 plus signed movement byte+0x2 use maxima. The definition flag0x10 path conditionally retargets carrier links+0x26 from the consumed slot to j before killing it.
formation.survivor: 0x82D13894..0x82D138CC writes selected U+0x4=1; rank+0x5=1 or2 when the combined rank exceeds3; selected movement, upgrade and two halfword results are written back.0x82D138E0 sets selected U+0x22=-1. The selected slot j survives this local scan; transitive callbacks retain separate lifetime conditions.
formation.refresh: The owner invokes frontend virtual+0x1B8(p,j) at0x82D138EC, conditionally virtual+0x1C0(6) for a local player, then virtual+0x1BC(p,j) at0x82D1395C.0x82D13968 calls recount0x82D11AD8(1,1), and0x82D1396C returns1. Actual callback targets, model/stat effect and transitive retention are not established by those slot numbers.

grantBoundary.result: A selected native formation producer is bound. Merely setting U+0x4 does not reproduce its eligibility, two-member consumption, state composition, carrier repair, callbacks or recount.
grantBoundary.existingUnits: Calling it on three newly created Archers does not guarantee only those new units are consumed: an earlier matching ordinary Archer on the same tile can be one of the first two matches. A grant must protect existing units without guessing a native exclusion or relocation contract.
grantBoundary.remaining: First-capital event receipt and persistence, frozen option/save policy, allocation failure recovery, actual callback targets and retained survivor, Archer eligibility in the reached state, and multiplayer execution/delivery remain required before a safe configurable grant is accepted.

scopedInterventionBoundary.cityInvocation: CityCreate0x82D18D88 saves the caller state, allocates0x180 bytes at0x82D18D94, saves entryX/Y at frame+0x19C/+0x1A4 and retains entryowner in r20 at0x82D18DC4. Reuse the accepted r16 city-index, success-tail and two founding-origin contract, while revalidating semantic current owner C+0 rather than assigning current-owner meaning to initial C+1 equality.
scopedInterventionBoundary.firstCapitalMarker: 0x82D19CD8..CE0 requires the selected owner city-count word to be zero;0x82D19CE4..CEC excludes the current Barbarian.0x82D19CFC..D08 tests the owner bit in0x830E5144; the clear arm stores the combined history word at0x82D19D14 and sets selected city+0x10 bit0 at0x82D19D20. The marker store is before the final successful return; reaching it alone is not a successful city result or a durable grant receipt.
scopedInterventionBoundary.formationFrame: 0x82D13620 allocates0xF0 bytes; retained owner, selected slot and candidate ordinal are r19,r26,r28.0x82D136B4 is the first candidate-record read, before candidate matching, state composition or killing.
scopedInterventionBoundary.skipDestination: 0x82D13884 increments candidate r28;0x82D13888 advances the record cursor by0x54 and0x82D1388C/90 loops while candidate<256. A conditional jump from0x82D136B4 to0x82D13884 therefore excludes one candidate without writing its record, while retaining the ordinary increment and selected-state accumulators.
scopedInterventionBoundary.requirements: Any title-owned filter must be scoped to the exact formation invocation and validate the intended fresh member identities. Eligibility counts all native matching records, so a narrowed member set needs independent proof of three eligible new units before entry and two actual retirements afterward. The native formation tail does not verify its selected-member count again before setting the army selector. Actual callback retention and failure cleanup remain separate conditions.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only Ghidra words from the supported image, fixed four-byte PowerPC decoding and exact generated-owner headers/end bounds. All emitted words matched the pinned flat image. No generated EOF body or setup body was read. The scoped-intervention follow-up emitted132 words across two already selected/native CityCreate owners.

guards: Native names and static calls establish this selected command path, not natural AI invocation, authority, completed delivery or runtime success.
Keep the caller's owner/slot bounds, supported readable record/definition extents, normal ABI retention and absence of external mutation explicit.
Do not replace formed-army semantics with three independent units, one flag write or the adjacent field-clear/creation owner.
Do not use the selected member scan to consume pre-existing units as an unqualified extra-unit grant.
falsification: Different mapper cells, branch words, matching predicates or survivor writes falsify the selected native route. Executed Archer creation/formation and callback lifetime evidence could extend the grant boundary; a name display alone cannot.
conclusion: Native command 10 MakeArmy reaches 0x82D13618, which requires eligibility, consumes two selected units of the same type on the same tile and updates the survivor through callbacks and recount. This closes the formation-producer identity question, but not a safe first-capital Archer army grant.
